info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Consumer Service Consumer Investment-spec
info.description: The Consumer Investment Management API allows businesses to facilitate and manage consumer investment services efficiently. Through this API, users can initiate new investment accounts, submit investment plans, and tailor financial products to meet the specific needs of consumers. It is primarily designed for financial institutions, investment platforms, and service providers looking to enhance their consumer investment offerings. Typical use cases include onboarding new consumers, managing investment portfolios, and integrating financial services into various applications.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new investment under their consumer services. It facilitates the submission of investment details and ensures the proper processing of the request, returning relevant investment information upon successful creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create new consumer investment records. The payload must include the necessary investment details such as amount, type, and consumer information in the specified JSON format.
